# DOAC

Direct oral anticoagulants (DOAC) are a class of anticoagulant medications analyzed in the report, with 2.33% of DOAC-treated patients experiencing serious bleeding.

## Mentions

- Page 72: "Andelen af patienter med alvorlig blødning er 2,33% for DOAC og 2,44% for marevan" [^src1]

## Claims

- Andelen af patienter med alvorlig blødning er 2,33% for DOAC og 2,44% for marevan ([[doac-anticoagulation]], [[marevan-anticoagulation|Marevan]])
